description: This Java class 'BrowserControl' provides methods to open URLs in a web browser, either via java.awt.Desktop or OS-specific commands, with platform detection and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: BrowserControl
classes.description: Utility class for opening URLs in a web browser with platform-specific handling and fallback.

methods.name: displayURL
methods.description: Attempts to open the provided URL using java.awt.Desktop; falls back to OS-specific commands if that fails.

methods.name: displayURLtraditional
methods.description: Uses OS-specific commands to open the URL in the default browser, with platform detection.

methods.name: isWindowsPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the current OS is Windows based on system properties.
